image.description: The complete pinned Bun.Image suite, unchanged.

webview-webkit.description: The complete pinned macOS Bun.WebView WebKit suite, unchanged, including Bun's re-executed native WebView host process.

runtime-smoke.description: Self-contained upstream coverage across Bun utilities, loaders, crypto, SQLite, HTTP, streams, and Node-facing objects.

runtime-subprocess-smoke.description: Pinned upstream checks whose bunExe() children use the supported runtime-only -e form.

portable-runtime.description: Every Bun/Node/Web test file that does not directly invoke bunExe() or bunRun().

runtime-subprocess.description: Files that invoke bunExe(), but do not visibly invoke a package-manager, bundler, or test CLI subcommand.

exclusions.cli: The file visibly invokes Bun package-manager, bundler, or other CLI subcommands; those commands are outside rbun's runtime-only compatibility target.
exclusions.mixed: The file mixes runtime subprocess checks with out-of-scope Bun CLI checks and needs test-case-level splitting before inclusion.
